what_it_would_do: Append one interval to each arm's budget["verified_human_waits"]. Budget.processing_seconds() subtracts verified intervals, so each arm's clock would exclude the outage and stop raising continuation_elapsed_cap. It relaxes a governance cap by editing durable state, which is why it is prepared rather than applied.
why_it_is_legitimate: The arms executed nothing between 2026-09-17T05:44:22Z (the last real model request, s-full J0002-implementation) and now. The clock measured an outage, not work: the Opus session limit killed the runner, and the coordinator then ordered a hold until the 12:00Z reset. arm_seconds is intended to bound how long an arm may spend WORKING.
